title: SK Hynix Defers Portion of HBM4 Back End Equipment Orders Until Next Year

tickers.name: SK hynix Inc. American Depositary Shares

summary:
Technical complications during the final stages of memory chip assembly may be slowing production at SK Hynix, based on industry speculation. The company has postponed some of its equipment orders for HBM4 back-end processing until next year, according to reports from DealSite and local Korean media.

Analysts suggest the shift in the investment schedule may be linked to product quality issues in the back-end of the HBM4 process. However, no direct connection between the deferral of packaging equipment and technical failures has been confirmed.
